sentences.text: The product note says that for individual borrowers on floating rate loans for non-business purposes, no foreclosure charge applies.
That matches the superseded RBI pre-payment charge directions, which said that for loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, an RE shall not levy pre-payment charges.

The currently in-force UCB rule found for this topic applies only to existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025, and it cannot be confirmed for this case because the sanction date is not provided.
So the note is consistent with the RBI rule text located for this loan type, but a current applicability check still needs the sanction date.

missing.searched: Checked the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 para 260 and the rule findings for applicability; the sanction date is needed to confirm whether the current UCB rule applies.
